title: 第17章 紫虚上人来第18章 升级与敌袭
content_zh:
第十七章 紫虚上人来
终于可以休息了，秦岚回到房间之后就迅速的开启了电脑，并且进入了游戏。
白天因为要去陌生的地方办事，为了避免别人发现什么，秦岚果断的关闭了电脑。虽然开着能够争取那么一天半天的时间，但是这个异世界与他之前所在的世界完全是两回事，他不懂是不是有什么奇人异事，万一被别人发现了他的秘密那可就大大的不妙。现在，那个不知所踪的电脑和异变的游戏，已经成为了他最大的依仗，不出意外的话，这辈子，这个秘密只有也只会有他一个人知道。
进入了游戏之中，城市里一切如昨，熙熙攘攘的市场里人来人往，喧嚣的酒馆依然是千米外都能听到它的吵闹声，城南角落的铁匠铺和工匠坊的机械制作声，也是时隐时现，现在这个城市已经有了初步的规模，随着民房和资源大多升到四级，城市也越发的热闹了起来。
走进城主府，黄卡田丰立刻过来请安。“主公，随着城市的发展提升，目前出现了两件紧急的事情需要处理，微臣不敢擅自做主，还请主公决判。”
咦？秦岚一听到这个消息，立刻就想到三国志中的紧急政务，一般这样的紧急事件，处理好了，都会有很不错的收获。果然，第一条是，城东的护城河河水泛滥，人民要求修建河堤和水坝，需要拨款三万六千黄金。毫无疑问，这个数目如果放在刚刚新建的热血三国城市中，绝对是囊中羞涩，想拿也拿不出。但是秦岚只是随意的点了点头，批准。
三万六黄金而已，他的库房中，不知道有多少。
获得了批准的田丰，立刻把这个政令发布了下去，很快，他又走了回来，“启禀主公，因为您的仁慈爱民，咸阳城民众深受鼓舞，民心提升十，人口增加一千。”
“呵呵……”秦岚浅笑了一下，这个效果他早知道了，所以并不意外，“第二件紧急事务是什么？”
“一个云游而来的邋遢道士，希望能够在我们城中设立祭坛祭奠天地，需要黄金六千，各类资源各一万，还要占据城池建造位置一格。”黄卡田丰面无表情，卡片将就是这样，没有太多的自主动作，也不会自动的去分析和决断。秦岚叹息一声，如果是真的名将田丰在自己的面前，那该有多好。
不过可惜的是，现在的他根本没有办法，就算真的田丰站在他面前，他也招募不到。
热血三国游戏中，原本只要官府到达二级，就可以用黄金和珠宝向汉朝购买官职，最低级的伍长只需要一万黄金就可以办到，有了官职，然后就可以通过进献黄金和珠宝晋升什长，里魁，亭长，啬夫，县长，县令……而有了官职，就可以购买爵位，最低级的是公士，其次是上造，然后是簪袅，不更，大夫……在确定自己可以继续在这个三国世界发展之后，秦岚第一时间就想购买爵位和官职，以尽快的发展其它城池，这样才能最快速度的研发科技以及出兵，去征讨其他势力和抓获真正的名将。
不过，让他失望的是，现在的他完全无法进献黄金珠宝，即便他的珠宝堆满了仓库，也不知道怎么进献……新手指导站在角落里用悦耳的声音提醒他，“尊敬的城主，您的城池还没有到达五级，在战乱的三国世界无法自保，请尽快打造一只军队，只有有了足够的防御力量，才能在战火纷飞中找到一处立脚之地。
军力，红卡姜维在这几天，已经招募了10个民夫，10个义兵，10个斥候，10个长枪兵，10个刀盾兵，10个弓箭手，10个轻骑兵，并且完成了训练。但是，这点兵力在那里都是不够看的，好在，田丰比较保守，他在城防建设上很下功夫，所以，现在的外城墙有一百一十个箭塔，还有几百个零散陷阱和拒马。
热血三国中，名将跟爵位是息息相关的，没有爵位，就没办法招募名将。不管你抓来的是谁，哪怕是属性超级垃圾的名将，他都会跟你说，“我的主公，必定是名震天下的xx，所以我是不会跟随你的。”
所以，秦岚打算尽快的升级官府到五级，然后看能不能进献珠宝，然后出去开分城。至于道士……等等？秦岚突然想到了，三国中的道士并不多，但是都是很出众的那种。难道……
“道士的名字叫什么，你问了吗？？”秦岚按捺住心中的激动，向身边的田丰询问，“是不是于吉？不是？那是南华？？也不是？司马徽？”
黄卡田丰一一摇头否定，看到秦岚的眼神转为失望，这才开口，“他说他的名字，叫做紫虚。”
紫虚上人！！！住在锦屏山不问世事的仙人紫虚上人？？？秦岚第一时间跳了起来，他怎么会来到我的城池？？？熟知三国历史以及三国游戏的秦岚，自然知道紫虚上人的存在。
三国历史中的紫虚上人虽然准确的预测了庞统的死亡以及诸葛亮的入川，但是他没有出手干涉过任何事，所以很少人知道他，名声也不如于吉和南华那般响亮。游戏中的紫虚上人也基本上都是隐藏任务才会出现的特殊人物，很少出现在众人面前，但是秦岚知道他绝对是不弱于于吉和南华等人的存在，或者说，他们的本事差不多，只是于吉和南华喜欢奔走世间，力图挽救苍生，而紫虚则是一直冷眼的看着世间。

批准！！
为什么不批准呢？？秦岚对黄卡田丰下达了命令，然后就转身向外走去，他要亲自去见见这个传说中的仙人。
不愧是能够预知未来的仙人，紫虚上人已经自顾自的在城市中心，端坐在他的破草蒲上等候着秦岚的到来了。直到秦岚走到他的面前，他才突然睁开了眼睛，那一闪而过的精光，显露了与他身上破烂邋遢的模样不一样的内在。
“见过上人。”秦岚的恭敬的拱手施礼。
“果然，果然。”紫虚上人却没有回礼，而是长笑一声，“南华啊南华，你说这个世界不可能出现身负九府紫虚之气的帝王，为何我就偏偏找到了？”
“？？？”
“老朽……紫虚，见过大人。还肯请大人允许老朽在这座城里建一座祭坛，为大人祈福。”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Master Zixu is coming
Finally able to rest, Qin Lan quickly turned on the computer and entered the game after returning to the room.
Because he had to go to a strange place to do business during the day, Qin Lan decisively turned off the computer in order to prevent others from discovering anything. Although driving can buy him a day and a half, this different world is completely different from the world he was in before. He doesn't know if there are any strange people and strange things. If someone discovers his secret, it will be very bad. Now, the missing computer and mutated game have become his biggest reliance. If nothing else happens, only he will know this secret in this life.
After entering the game, everything in the city is as it was yesterday. People are coming and going in the bustling market. The noise of the noisy tavern can still be heard thousands of meters away. The sound of mechanical production in the blacksmith shop and craftsman workshop in the south corner of the city is also disappearing and appearing. Now the city has reached a preliminary scale. With most of the private houses and resources upgraded to level four, the city is becoming more and more lively.
Entering the city lord's mansion, Huangka Tianfeng immediately came over to say hello. "Lord, with the development of the city, there are currently two urgent matters that need to be dealt with. I dare not make the decision without authorization, and I still ask the lord to make a decision."
Huh? As soon as Qin Lan heard the news, he immediately thought of the urgent government affairs in the Three Kingdoms. Generally, if such emergencies are handled well, there will be good results. Sure enough, the first one was that the moat in the east of the city was overflowing, and the people asked for the construction of embankments and dams, which required an allocation of 36,000 gold. There is no doubt that if this amount is placed in the newly built city of the Three Kingdoms, it will definitely be cash-strapped, and it will be impossible to take it out even if you want to. But Qin Lan just nodded casually in approval.
It's only thirty-six thousand gold. He doesn't know how much he has in his warehouse.
After receiving the approval, Tian Feng immediately issued the decree. Soon, he came back and said, "My lord, because of your kindness and love for the people, the people of Xianyang City are deeply inspired. The people's moral support has increased by ten, and the population has increased by one thousand."
"Haha..." Qin Lan smiled slightly. He had known this effect for a long time, so he was not surprised. "What is the second urgent matter?"
"A sloppy Taoist priest who came from wandering hopes to set up an altar in our city to worship the world. He needs 6,000 gold, 10,000 various resources, and occupies one city construction slot." Huang Ka Tianfeng's face was expressionless. The card will be like this. He doesn't have many independent actions, and he won't automatically analyze and make decisions. Qin Lan sighed, how great it would be if the real famous general Tian Feng was in front of him.
But it's a pity that he has no choice now. Even if Tian Feng really stands in front of him, he can't recruit him.
In the game "Hot Blooded Three Kingdoms", as long as the government reaches the second level, you can use gold and jewels to buy official positions from the Han Dynasty. The lowest-ranking corps commander only needs 10,000 gold. Once you have an official position, you can then donate gold and jewelry to be promoted to chief, likui, pavilion chief, stingy husband, county magistrate, county magistrate... and with an official position, you can purchase a title. The lowest level is Gongshi, followed by Shangzao, then Hairpin, doctor... After confirming that he can continue to develop in the world of the Three Kingdoms, Qin Lan immediately wanted to buy titles and official positions to develop other cities as quickly as possible, so that he could research and develop technology as quickly as possible and send troops to conquer other forces and capture real famous generals.
However, what disappoints him is that now he is completely unable to donate gold jewels. Even if his jewels are piled up in the warehouse, he doesn't know how to donate them... The novice instructor stood in the corner and reminded him in a pleasant voice, "Dear City Lord, your city has not reached level five and cannot protect itself in the war-torn Three Kingdoms world. Please build an army as soon as possible. Only with sufficient defense powerOnly by measuring strength can we find a foothold in the raging war.
In terms of military strength, Hongka Jiangwei has recruited 10 civilians, 10 volunteers, 10 scouts, 10 spearmen, 10 sword and shield soldiers, 10 archers, and 10 light cavalry in the past few days, and completed training. However, this small amount of troops is not enough there. Fortunately, Tian Feng is relatively conservative and he has worked hard on city defense construction. Therefore, the outer city wall now has 110 arrow towers, as well as hundreds of scattered traps and horse resistance.
In the Three Kingdoms, famous generals are closely related to their titles. Without titles, there is no way to recruit famous generals. No matter who you capture, even if it is a famous general with super rubbish attributes, he will tell you, "My lord must be a world-famous xx, so I will not follow you."
Therefore, Qin Lan plans to upgrade the government to level five as soon as possible, then see if he can donate jewelry, and then go out to open a branch city. As for the Taoist priest...wait? Qin Lan suddenly thought that there were not many Taoist priests in the Three Kingdoms, but they were all outstanding ones. Could it be...
"What is the name of the Taoist priest? Have you asked??" Qin Lan suppressed the excitement in her heart and asked Tian Feng beside her, "Is it Yu Ji? No? That's Nanhua? Or not? Sima Hui?"
Huang Ka Tianfeng shook his head in denial one by one. Seeing Qin Lan's eyes turn to disappointment, he said, "He said his name is Zixu."
Master Zixu! ! ! Master Zixu, the immortal who lives in Jinping Mountain and doesn’t care about worldly affairs? ? ? Qin Lan jumped up immediately, how could he come to my city? ? ? Qin Lan, who is familiar with the history of the Three Kingdoms and the games of the Three Kingdoms, naturally knows about the existence of Master Zixu.
Although Master Zixu in the history of the Three Kingdoms accurately predicted Pang Tong's death and Zhuge Liang's entry into Sichuan, he did not interfere in anything, so few people know about him, and his reputation is not as loud as Yu Ji and Nan Hua. Master Zixu in the game is basically a special character who only appears on hidden missions and rarely appears in front of everyone, but Qin Lan knows that he is definitely not weaker than Yu Ji, Nan Hua and others. In other words, their abilities are similar, but Yu Ji and Nan Hua like to run around the world and try to save the people, while Zixu always looks at the world coldly.
approve! !
Why not approve it? ? Qin Lan gave the order to Huang Ka Tianfeng, and then turned around and walked out. He wanted to meet this legendary immortal in person.
As expected of an immortal who can predict the future, Master Zixu was already minding his own business in the center of the city, sitting on his ragged grass and waiting for Qin Lan's arrival. It wasn't until Qin Lan walked in front of him that he suddenly opened his eyes. The flash of light revealed an inner being that was different from the tattered and slovenly look on his body.
"I've met the Master." Qin Lan bowed her hands respectfully.
"As expected, as expected." Master Zixu did not return the greeting, but gave a long laugh, "Nanhua, Nanhua, you said that it is impossible for an emperor with the energy of Zixu of the Nine Palaces to appear in this world, why did I just find it?"
"???"
"Old man... Zixu, I have met you, sir. I would like to ask your permission to build an altar in this city to pray for you."
